subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Ler e escrever corretamente palavras com sílabas CV, V, CVC, CCV, VC, VV, CVV, identificando que existem vogais em todas as sílabas.

components.description_pt: Identificar vogal como núcleo obrigatório de toda sílaba
components.description_en: Identify the vowel as the obligatory nucleus of every syllable
components.cc_component_description: Apply the rule that every syllable contains a vowel sound to count syllables in a word

components.description_pt: Ler palavras com estruturas silábicas CV, V, CVC, CCV, VC, VV e CVV
components.description_en: Read words with CV, V, CVC, CCV, VC, VV, and CVV syllable structures
components.cc_component_description: Blend individual phonemes to read regularly spelled one-syllable words accurately

components.description_pt: Classificar sílabas em palavra de acordo com sua estrutura fonológica
components.description_en: Classify syllables in a word according to their phonological structure
components.cc_component_description: Segment spoken words into individual syllables

cc_matches.description: Use knowledge that every syllable must have a vowel sound to determine the number of syllables in a printed word.
Demonstrate understanding of spoken words, syllables, and sounds (phonemes).
